definitions.explanation: Grass or other plants that have been cut and dried for use as animal feed or bedding. A fundamental agricultural product used especially for feeding horses, cattle, and other livestock.

examples.english: I give hay to the horses.

examples.japanese: ⟦{納屋|なや}→納屋：20219_naya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{干|ほ}し{草|くさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{積|つ}んであった→積む：02294_tsumu⟧。
examples.english: Lots of hay was stacked up in the barn.

examples.japanese: ⟦{牧場|ぼくじょう}→牧場：06103_bokujou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{干|ほ}し{草|くさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}って→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}える→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧。
examples.english: At the ranch, they make hay during summer to prepare for winter.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{干|ほ}す→干す：00115_hosu⟧ (to dry) + ⟦{草|くさ}→草：02206_kusa⟧ (grass). Written as {干し草|ほしくさ} or {干草|ほしくさ}. The round bales of hay seen in pastoral landscapes are called {干|ほ}し{草|くさ}⟦ロール→ロール：11709_rooru⟧ or ⟦{牧草|ぼくそう}→牧草：25486_bokusou⟧⟦ロール→ロール：11709_rooru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {干|ほ}し{草|くさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{刈|か}る→刈る：02043_karu⟧: to cut hay
- {干|ほ}し{草|くさ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧: haystack
- {干|ほ}し{草|くさ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{匂|にお}い→匂い：00874_nioi⟧: the smell of hay
- {干|ほ}し{草|くさ}⟦アレルギー→アレルギー：04645_arerugii⟧: hay allergy

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{牧草|ぼくそう}→牧草：25486_bokusou⟧: pasture grass, fodder — fresh or dried grass for livestock
- {藁|わら}: straw — dried stalks of grain crops like rice, distinct from hay
- ⟦{飼料|しりょう}→飼料：19666_shiryou⟧: animal feed — the general term for all livestock feed
